basic_info.description: This spacious and well-appointed Noe Valley Condo offers two levels of contemporary living with an exceptional backyard oasis - all in a highly coveted location.     With a house-like feel, the open floor plan features a Chef's kitchen, complete with top-of-the-line appliances, modern cabinetry and ample counter space, perfect for entertaining guests.    With three spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms, this home is designed with your comfort and convenience in mind. The Grand Primary Suite boasts a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-like bathroom with double vanity, soaking tub, and shower. The two other bedrooms offer large windows with serene outlooks and share a full-size bath with shower over tub.  Built in 2002, this home offers the perfect balance of modern features and classic elegance and includes a 1-car parking space with interior access  and deeded storage for all your extra belongings. Incredible location minutes from locals favorites on 24th St., parks, shuttle bus stops & freeway.
